gloss: to incorporate, to include, to pack in

definitions.gloss: to incorporate, to include, to work into
definitions.explanation: To include or incorporate content, ideas, or elements into a plan, document, proposal, or creative work. Often used in business and formal contexts when adding items to plans or policies.

definitions.gloss: to heap into, to pack into, to fill with
definitions.explanation: To pile or pack food or other items generously into a container. The literal, physical sense of filling something up.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{提案|ていあん}を{計画|けいかく}に{盛|も}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I incorporated the new proposal into the plan.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}{案|あん}に{教育|きょういく}{支援|しえん}の{項目|こうもく}を{盛|も}り{込|こ}む{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: We plan to incorporate an education support item into the budget proposal.

examples.japanese: {契約書|けいやくしょ}には{双方|そうほう}の{権利|けんり}と{義務|ぎむ}を{明確|めいかく}に{盛|も}り{込|こ}む{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: It is necessary to clearly incorporate the rights and obligations of both parties into the contract.

examples.japanese: お{弁当|べんとう}{箱|ばこ}におかずを{盛|も}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I packed the side dishes into the lunch box.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{器|うつわ}にサラダをたっぷり{盛|も}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I heaped a generous amount of salad into a large bowl.

examples.japanese: {丼|どんぶり}に{具材|ぐざい}をこれでもかと{盛|も}り{込|こ}んで、{豪快|ごうかい}な{一品|いっぴん}に{仕上|しあ}げた。
examples.english: I packed the bowl to the brim with toppings and finished it as a hearty dish.

notes:
FORMATION:
{盛|も}る (to heap, to serve) + {込|こ}む (into). The {込|こ}む suffix adds the nuance of putting something into or packing something in.

USAGE:
Sense 1 (incorporate) is more common in modern usage, especially in business, government, and media contexts. The passive form {盛|も}り{込|こ}まれる (to be incorporated) is very frequent in news articles about policy and legislation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {計画|けいかく}に{盛|も}り{込|こ}む: incorporate into a plan
- {予算|よさん}に{盛|も}り{込|こ}む: include in a budget
- {内容|ないよう}を{盛|も}り{込|こ}む: incorporate content
- {条件|じょうけん}を{盛|も}り{込|こ}む: include conditions
